item.title: Look Up: Through the Valley
item.description:
Read: Scripture Psalm 23:1–4 NIV

Tap or hover over the reference to read the full passage without leaving the page. Notice particularly the movement through the Psalm: from green pastures and quiet waters, along right paths and into the darkest valley, where David can still say, “for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.”

Psalm 23 is probably one of the best-known passages in the Bible. It is a favorite at funerals, and perhaps because we hear it so often in that setting, we can begin to think of it primarily as a Psalm about dying.

item.title: If God Knows, Why Pray?
item.description:
After hours · a continuing series

Late Night Questions

My wife is a midwife, and some of the more difficult theological and ethical questions in our house have a habit of arriving after a late shift, usually when we're both tired and neither of us is expecting a theological discussion.

This series is an attempt to keep track of those questions: not necessarily to find a neat answer, but to look at Scripture, draw on writers who have helped me think, and work out what I actually believe and why.
